description: Configure messages that should get send when a user joins a Voice-Channel

content.name: channels
content.description: Channel-ID in which this messages should get triggered

content.name: message
content.description: Here you can set the message that should be send if someone joins a selected voicechat

content.name: notify_channel_id
content.description: Channel where the message should be send

content.name: cooldownEnabled
content.description: When enabled, messages will only be sent once per channel within the cooldown period

content.name: cooldownMinutes
content.description: Duration in minutes to wait before sending another message for the same channel

content.name: send_pn_to_member
content.description: Should the bot send a PN to the member?

content.name: pn_message
